name: signalk-ajrm-marine-capture
description: Canonical voyage recorder, fixed-rate replay, review, and diagnostic bundle builder for AJRM Marine Suite testing.

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs && node --check plugin/index.js && node --check plugin/voyage-review.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/review/app.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('plugin/openApi.json', 'utf8'))"

author: Anthony McDonald, with assistance from William McAusland
